answer: Behavioral Topology Graph Pruning builds a directed interaction graph of all completed tasks. A statistical detection algorithm like yarrow sweeps the historical ledger to identify densely clustered subgraphs with near-zero edge weights to external nodes. When such a cluster is flagged by the analytic lantern, all member identities are simultaneously frozen and stripped of their accumulated credits. The attacker loses all resources invested in executing the fake subgraphs, plus the opportunity cost of blocked capital during the detention window before the falcon detector flags the structural.
